notes.title: The Update for the Demo Version!
notes.notes:
The demo version has been updated to version 0.1.1!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3395680/

[h1]What's New:[/h1]

[b]1. [/b]Centered the 'Live Chat' header,
[b]2. [/b]Fixed a bug related to pressing the Ctrl button in the 'Lucky Wheel' app and disabled the ability to close it while the wheel is spinning (no cheating!),
[b]3. [/b]Implemented a check for the nickname entered by players to ensure it is not already registered on Twilck,
[b]4. [/b]Resolved an issue with a comment appearing early in the chat,
[b]5. [/b]Updated the 'Lines' mini-game:
   - Added difficulty levels
   - Established a minimum limit on the number of participating colors
   - Revised the system for accruing game money
   - Increased the maximum size of the playing board
   - Darkened the cells of the playing board
   - Added the option to finish the game at any time and take your winnings

Don't forget to share your suggestions and feedback in the Steam community!

[i]Enjoy,
Noasaki & Orizori[/i]
